preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver an evidence-ready, player-facing locomotion and first-person camera pass across the accepted authored spawn-to-Alpha route: all ordinary movement modes and independent mouse look must remain human-scaled, grounded, collision-safe, visually stable, and deterministically resettable while preserving the intact environment and prior accepted behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: The required check is unverified, not failed: the accepted candidate already has a CharacterBody3D controller, independent mouse look, grounded spawn-to-Alpha traversal, collision, and explicit walk/sprint/crouch/jump states, but prior formal evidence covers only basic movement, look, restart, and route traversal. It does not exercise the weapon-foundation acceptance matrix of walk, strafe, sprint, crouch, jump/land, and look across the authored route while confirming stable camera height/FOV, ground contact, collision, and rendering. The smallest coherent increment is to harden any behavior exposed by that matrix and make its live states observable without changing the preserved environment or starting backlog weapon work.

stop_conditions: Do not modify, replace, duplicate, extract, or reposition the accepted authored environment instance or its child meshes; stop and report if success would require such a change.
Do not begin AK-74M, Saiga-12, viewmodel, combat-causality, HUD, minimap, enemy, or other backlog work in this iteration.
Do not tune movement, camera, lighting, materials, or map transforms merely because the check is unverified; change only behavior contradicted by focused runtime inspection.
Stop and report if ordinary-input traversal exposes a collision, navigation, or ground-datum defect that cannot be repaired additively without invalidating the preserved arena-foundation evidence.
Stop after focused candidate self-validation; GameLoop Runtime and QA Tester own fresh evidence capture, formal verdicts, and phase closure.

strategy.rationale: Use the accepted map and controller as the baseline, then exercise the missing ordinary-input state matrix before making bounded changes. Preserve existing human-scale parameters and world bindings when they already pass; repair only demonstrated controller, stance-clearance, grounding, reset, or camera-stability defects, and expose concise runtime state needed for host recapture.

code: Confirm project.godot retains ordinary keyboard/gamepad movement actions and physical F6 restart with no restart binding on physical R.
Review the controller for normalized yaw-relative movement, grounded jump gating, stance-safe capsule changes, bounded pitch, deterministic reset, and truthful runtime-state fields.
Verify main.tscn retains one CharacterBody3D player, one current Camera3D, the accepted human-scale capsule/camera configuration, and no new player-facing debug overlay.
Run the frozen clean-boot validation and reject new parse, missing-resource, or runtime errors.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester should start from physical F6 and use the movement-effect capture recipe to exercise walk, lateral strafe, forward sprint, crouch movement, jump/airborne/land, and independent horizontal/vertical look through ordinary input.

At each transition, compare runtime state with input and motion: locomotion mode, stance, floor state, jump phase, speed, camera height/FOV/forward vector, collision, and stand-clearance predicates must agree.

Traverse representative authored surfaces from spawn toward Alpha and verify stable ground contact, collision containment, route progress, and Alpha entry/exit authority without teleporting, debug setters, or proxy support.
Repeat physical F6 after displacement, rotation, crouch, and jump activity; verify exact spawn restoration and confirm physical R does not reset the player.
visual: Capture sparse matched 16:9 gameplay views at standing spawn, moving/looking on the route, crouched beside representative cover, and jump/landing recovery; each frame must retain human-scale eye level and readable authored geometry.
Compare standing, sprinting, and crouched framing for camera clipping, abrupt datum changes, excessive motion, exposure shifts, shimmer, missing surfaces, or visibility outside the authored map.

Confirm the accepted daylight environment remains the sole visual world, with its native structures/materials intact and no proxy floor, duplicated map, decorative patch, HUD, weapon, or debug telemetry visible.

done_when: Ordinary keyboard input produces distinct, truthful idle, walk, strafe, sprint, crouch/crouch-idle, jump, airborne, landing, and grounded states without diagonal speed inflation or repeated airborne jumping.

Crouching changes both capsule and eye height while retaining ground contact, standing is blocked under insufficient clearance, and releasing crouch restores the standing capsule and camera only when safe.
Independent mouse look retains a current first-person camera, bounded pitch, stable yaw, readable 76-degree-class framing, and human-scale standing eye height while moving through the authored route.

Walk, strafe, sprint, crouch, jump, and landing remain collision-safe on representative spawn-to-Alpha surfaces, with no fall-through, wall escape, camera clipping, unintended exposure shift, shimmer, or disappearing map surfaces.

Physical F6 deterministically restores the fixed spawn, zero velocity, standing stance, grounded locomotion state, zero yaw/pitch, and captured mouse; physical R remains available for later reload work and does not restart.

Runtime state exposes the active locomotion mode, stance, grounded/jump phase, horizontal speed, target speed, stand clearance, camera height/FOV/forward vector, and bounded route samples without displaying debug telemetry in the player-facing view.
The single authored environment instance, wrapper datum, collision/navigation support, fixed spawn, Alpha overlap authority, and bounded Alpha event history remain intact and operational.
The candidate still boots cleanly and introduces no weapon, HUD, minimap, enemy AI, decorative asset, or unrelated mission-system scope.
tasks.instructions: Audit the existing controller with ordinary input across the accepted spawn-to-Alpha route, then implement only the smallest product-owned changes required to make walk, strafe, sprint, crouch, jump/airborne/land, and independent mouse look robust together. Keep movement relative to player yaw, normalized across diagonals, grounded through the existing authored collision, and governed by explicit stance and floor state. Preserve the current human-scale capsule, standing eye height, camera FOV, mouse capture, pitch limit, and physical-F6 reset when runtime frames show they are already correct. Ensure crouch changes capsule and eye height coherently, cannot stand into overhead geometry, and does not introduce a camera pop or ground-datum shift; ensure jump is standing-and-grounded only and landing settles deterministically. Extend existing candidate-owned runtime state or route instrumentation only as needed to expose each exercised mode, camera values, collision/grounding, and bounded samples for host recapture. Do not place diagnostic text in the normal viewport, alter the intact environment, or implement backlog weapon/HUD work.
